description: Rename 'Chatbot' sidebar group to 'Maestr.IA', add WhatsApp Templates to the group nav, and apply per-item role filtering so config pages are hidden from viewers/members. Independent of FEAT-001 (no cross-file dependencies).
steps: Read `c:\automacoes\C8 Control\src\pages\public-dashboard\PublicDashboardSidebar.tsx` fully to understand the current CHATBOT_NAV definition, AccordionGroup usage, and the CONFIG_NAV role-filtering pattern.

In `PublicDashboardSidebar.tsx`, update CHATBOT_NAV to add a Templates entry: `{ title: 'Templates WhatsApp', url: 'mensagens/templates', icon: MessageCircle }`. Import `MessageCircle` if not already imported (it is already imported in the file).
In `PublicDashboardSidebar.tsx`, rename the AccordionGroup label from 'Chatbot' to 'Maestr.IA' in the JSX block that renders the chatbot section (search for `label="Chatbot"`).

In `PublicDashboardSidebar.tsx`, apply role filtering to the CHATBOT_NAV SidebarMenu render: wrap the map with a filter so that items with url matching `chatbot/agente`, `chatbot/conhecimento`, `chatbot/fluxos` are only shown when `['owner','admin','manager'].includes(userRole)`. The `chatbot/canais` and `mensagens/templates` items remain visible to all authenticated users (member+). Pattern to follow: the existing CONFIG_NAV filter block in the same component.
Verify the sidebar still shows the Maestr.IA group gated on `chatbotEnabled` (`modules_config?.automation_enabled === true`).

Templates WhatsApp and Canais remain visible to all authenticated users.
